name: The Hundred
description: Lying on the back with the head and shoulders curled up and the legs lifted, the arms pump in small beats while you breathe in a steady rhythm.
cues: Keep the ribs drawn in and the neck long. Breathe in for five pumps and out for five.

name: Single Leg Stretch
description: Curled up with one knee drawn in and the other leg reaching long, switching legs smoothly while the upper body stays still.
cues: Keep the pelvis steady and the chest lifted. Reach long through the extended leg.

name: Double Leg Stretch
description: Curled up, the arms and legs reach away from the centre together and then circle back in to hug the knees.
cues: Keep the lower back heavy. Only reach as far as you can control.

name: Criss-Cross
description: Curled up with the hands behind the head, rotate the upper body towards the opposite knee while the other leg extends.
cues: Rotate from the ribcage, not the elbows. Keep the pelvis still.

name: Rolling Like a Ball
description: Balanced on the sitting bones while holding the shins, roll back along the rounded spine and come back up to the balance.
cues: Keep the same round shape the whole way. Roll on the back, never on the neck.

name: Spine Stretch Forward
description: Sitting tall with the legs apart, curve forward over the hips one segment at a time and then stack back up.
cues: Imagine lengthening over a large ball. Keep the sitting bones heavy.

name: Roll Down
description: Sitting with the knees bent, curl the tailbone under and roll back one segment at a time as far as you can control, then return.
cues: Keep the abdominals scooped and move slowly. Stop where the shape would break.

name: Single Leg Circles
description: Lying on the back with one leg reaching up, draw small controlled circles with that leg while the pelvis stays still.
cues: Keep the hips level. Make the circle from the hip joint.

name: Side Kick Front and Back
description: Lying on the side with the top leg lifted, swing the leg forward and back while the trunk stays steady.
cues: Stack the hips and keep the waist lifted. The movement comes from the hip.

name: Child's Pose
description: Kneeling and sitting back towards the heels with the arms reaching forward, resting the torso over the thighs.
cues: Let the breath move into the back. Relax the neck and shoulders.

name: Hamstring Stretch Supine
description: Lying on the back, bring one leg up and hold it gently behind the thigh or calf while the other leg rests long.
cues: Keep the lifted leg's hip relaxed and the lower back long. Stretch without forcing.

name: Seal
description: Balanced on the sitting bones with the feet held by the hands inside the knees, roll back and forth keeping one steady round shape.
cues: Keep the shape compact and the head heavy. Tap the feet lightly at each end.

name: Saw
description: Sitting tall with the legs apart and the arms wide, rotate the trunk and reach the front hand past the opposite foot.
cues: Rotate around a long spine. Keep both hips anchored.

name: Side Lying Leg Lifts
description: Lying on the side, lift and lower the top leg in a controlled line while the trunk stays stable.
cues: Keep the top hip slightly forward and avoid rolling back.

name: Side Lying Arm Openings
description: Lying on the side with the arms together in front, open the top arm across the body in a wide arc and return.
cues: Let the ribcage rotate with the arm. Keep the knees stacked.

name: Swimming
description: Lying face down with the arms and legs reaching long, lift the chest slightly and flutter the opposite arm and leg.
cues: Keep the neck long and reach out through the fingers and toes.

name: Single Leg Kick
description: Lying face down propped on the forearms, alternate bending each knee towards the seat with a gentle double pulse.
cues: Keep the chest lifted and the abdominals drawn in.

name: Pelvic Curl with Ball Squeeze
description: Lying on the carriage with a small ball between the knees, roll the pelvis up into a bridge while gently squeezing the ball.
cues: Keep the squeeze light and even. Articulate one bone at a time.

name: Chest Lift with Ball
description: Lying on the carriage with the ball held at the chest, curl the head and shoulders up and lower with control.
cues: Breathe out as you lift. Keep the ribs soft and the chin level.

name: Parallel Heels with Ball
description: Lying on the carriage with the heels on the bar and a ball between the ankles, press the carriage out and bring it back in.
cues: Keep a gentle squeeze on the ball. Do not let the knees drift apart.

name: Parallel Toes with Ball
description: The same footwork with the balls of the feet on the bar and a small ball between the ankles.
cues: Keep the heels lifted evenly and the squeeze steady.

name: Hundred Prep with Ball
description: Lying on the carriage with the knees bent over the hips and a ball between the knees, curl up and pump the arms in small beats.
cues: Keep the squeeze steady and the neck relaxed.

name: Curl-Up with Ball Overhead
description: Holding the ball overhead, curl up and reach the ball towards the knees, then roll down and take the arms back overhead.
cues: Move the ball with the ribcage. Keep the lower back heavy.

name: Frog with Ball Squeeze
description: Lying on the carriage with the feet in the straps and a ball between the knees, bend and extend the legs while squeezing lightly.
cues: Keep the pelvis still. Press out along a long diagonal.

name: Leg Circles with Ball Squeeze
description: Lying on the carriage with the legs in the straps and a ball between the knees, draw small circles with both legs together.
cues: Keep the ball held steady and the pelvis quiet.

name: Bottom Lift with Ball Squeeze
description: With the feet on the bar and a ball between the knees, peel the spine up into a bridge and roll back down one bone at a time.
cues: Press evenly through both feet and keep the squeeze gentle.

name: Seated Forward Fold with Ball
description: Sitting tall on the carriage holding the ball in front, round forward over the ball and stack back up.
cues: Let the head lead the curve and keep the shoulders wide.

name: Seated Rotation with Ball
description: Sitting tall on the carriage holding the ball at chest height, rotate the trunk to one side and then the other.
cues: Turn from the ribcage and keep both sitting bones heavy.

name: Ball Roll-Out
description: Kneeling with the forearms on the ball, roll the ball forward and back while the body stays in one line.
cues: Keep the abdominals drawn in and avoid sinking through the lower back.

name: Side Lying Ball Lift
description: Lying on the side with the ball between the ankles, lift and lower both legs together in a controlled line.
cues: Keep the waist lifted and the squeeze light.

name: Prone Ball Extension
description: Lying face down with the ball under the hips or pelvis, lift the chest slightly while the legs stay long.
cues: Keep the neck long and lift only as high as feels strong and comfortable.

name: Ball Overhead Reach
description: Sitting tall holding the ball with both hands, reach it overhead and lower it back down in front of the chest.
cues: Keep the shoulders down and the ribs closed.

name: Ball Chest Press
description: Sitting tall holding the ball with both hands, press the ball forward and draw it back to the chest.
cues: Press evenly with both hands and keep the neck relaxed.
